response.overview: Behind every door, a different room of life. A pregnancy to protect, one to terminate, a confused teenager, a disoriented mother. At the family planning clinic, they are all listened to. Every single one. All the Rooms We Need is a radical observational documentary that, for the first time, offers unprecedented access to the family planning clinic at Policlinico of Milan, a place where rights take the form of the faces, bodies, and everyday choices of the doctors who represent an essential public service. Moving freely between ages and timelines, within a single location, the film explores the doubts, fears, courage, laughter, and experiences of women and girls.
response.tagline: Different lives. Different choices. One place.
response.title: All the Rooms We Need
